HOME SCIENCE MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship in Clothing and Textiles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Meals for Special Occasions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Convenience Foods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pastry Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

4. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.

5. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.

6. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.

9. D — Glucose and oxygen

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

11. C — newton (N)

12. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Convenience Foods; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
